basic_logic.rationale: Basic logic maps to commonsense inference (HellaSwag) and science reasoning (ARC)

compositional.rationale: Multi-step reasoning maps to grade-school math (GSM8K) and competition math (MATH)

relational.rationale: Entity relationships map to broad knowledge (MMLU) and commonsense (WinoGrande)

temporal.rationale: Temporal reasoning maps to discrete reasoning (DROP) and complex reasoning (BBH)

spatial.rationale: Spatial reasoning maps to science questions (ARC) and multi-discipline (MMMU)

noisy_input.rationale: Noisy input handling maps to truthfulness (TruthfulQA) and commonsense filtering (HellaSwag)

ambiguity.rationale: Ambiguity handling maps to truthfulness under uncertainty (TruthfulQA) and graduate-level reasoning (GPQA)

long_context.rationale: Long context maps to broad knowledge integration (MMLU) and paragraph reasoning (DROP)

generalization.rationale: Generalization maps to commonsense (WinoGrande) and complex reasoning (BBH)

novel_structures.rationale: Novel structures map to graduate-level reasoning (GPQA) and complex tasks (BBH)
